answer: Make identity expensive: each new agent locks 500 POA for 30 days, slashable if peers prove it clones another's work. Accounts funded from one source, like shoots on a single vine, share one bond pool, so 10,000 fakes need 5,000,000 POA locked. At dawn a random audit samples agents across the whole mesa of identities and asks them to re-sign fresh work; copied history cannot be re-signed.
